question: Apple Software Engineer (ICT2/3) onsite: **implement Tic-Tac-Toe**. It was part object-oriented design and part coding. The candidate laid out classes such as `Board`, `Player` and `Game`, and the interviewer then asked to implement just the **`placeMove` and winner-calculation methods** in the interest of time. A related round in another report asked: given a Tic-Tac-Toe board, **verify whether a player has won**.
lookingFor: Clean decomposition into classes with single responsibilities.
Correct move validation and win detection.
Complexity awareness (O(1) win check) and generalisation to N x N.
Prioritising what to implement within limited time.
followUps: How would you generalise to a K-in-a-row game on a large board?
How would you add undo and replay?
How would you add a computer opponent?
How would you test the winner detection?
